name: EJ Christian Medilo
aboutSummary: I’m EJ Christian Medilo, a software developer and BSIT student at STI College Global City. I enjoy turning ideas into practical software systems that solve real problems.
aiApproach: I use AI tools to support planning, development, and problem-solving. Building systems with AI assistance helps me explore approaches, understand unfamiliar concepts, and learn throughout the development process.
aiLearning: I’m currently studying AI Engineering to strengthen my technical foundation and learn how to apply AI effectively in useful software.
intro: I build full-stack web and native Android applications, connecting clear interfaces, reliable APIs, and data. I’m continuing to grow as a software developer and explore AI engineering.
summary: Software Developer and BSIT student at STI College Global City, with hands-on experience in frontend and backend development, REST API integration, database management, and application security. I build practical web and Android applications while continuing to develop my software engineering skills and explore AI engineering.
goal: I’m strengthening my full-stack development practice: designing clear interfaces, building reliable APIs, and deploying applications that solve practical problems. I’m also exploring how AI can support useful software experiences.
interests: I’m interested in AI and emerging technologies: discovering new tools, experimenting with AI-assisted development, and understanding how technology can improve software and user experiences.
hobbies: Outside development, I enjoy online games, movies, and anime. Gaming gives me a mix of competitive and collaborative experiences; movies and anime let me explore different stories, characters, and creative worlds.
workWithMe: I’m open to software development opportunities and collaboration on practical web and Android projects. I enjoy working with other developers, learning through real problems, and exploring emerging technology.
